nodes.summary: The set $E$ consists of the codes $c$ of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ that are defined on no input: for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the function computed by $c$ is undefined at $n$.
nodes.title: Codes with empty domain

nodes.summary: The set $EQ$ consists of the pairs $(c_1, c_2)$ of codes of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ that recognize the same language, that is, whose computed functions have the same domain: for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the function computed by $c_1$ is defined at $n$ if and only if the function computed by $c_2$ is.
nodes.title: Equivalent codes

nodes.summary: There is a code $e$ of a partial recursive function on $\mathbb{N}$ whose computed function is the empty partial function, undefined at every input.
nodes.title: A code defined nowhere

nodes.summary: For a code $c$ of a partial recursive function on $\mathbb{N}$, the code $h(c)$ is the composition $k_0 \circ c \circ k_0$, where $k_0$ is the code of the constant function $0$: whatever its input, $h(c)$ runs $c$ on $0$ and, if this halts, outputs $0$.
nodes.title: Halting-on-zero code

nodes.summary: The set $E$ of codes of partial recursive functions defined on no input is many-one reducible to the set $EQ$ of pairs of codes with the same domain: there is a computable map $f$ from codes to pairs of codes such that, for every code $c$, $c \in E$ if and only if $f(c) \in EQ$.
nodes.title: Emptiness reduces to equivalence

nodes.summary: The set of codes $c$ of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ that halt on input $0$ (are defined at $0$) is many-one reducible to the set $EQ$ of pairs of codes with the same domain: there is a computable map $f$ from codes to pairs of codes such that, for every code $c$, $c$ halts on $0$ if and only if $f(c) \in EQ$.
nodes.title: Halting on zero reduces to equivalence

nodes.summary: The set $EQ$ of pairs of codes of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ with the same domain is not co-recognizable by multi-stack machines: no multi-stack machine, started on the binary encoding of a pair of codes, halts exactly when the pair is not in $EQ$.
nodes.title: Equivalence is not co-recognizable

nodes.summary: The set $E$ of codes of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ that are defined on no input is not decidable by multi-stack machines.
nodes.title: Emptiness is undecidable

nodes.summary: The set $E$ of codes of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ that are defined on no input is not recognizable by multi-stack machines: no multi-stack machine, started on the binary encoding of a code, halts exactly when the code is in $E$.
nodes.title: Emptiness is not recognizable

nodes.summary: The set $EQ$ of pairs of codes of partial recursive functions on $\mathbb{N}$ with the same domain is not recognizable by multi-stack machines: no multi-stack machine, started on the binary encoding of a pair of codes, halts exactly when the pair is in $EQ$.
nodes.title: Equivalence is not recognizable

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions $\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ that are defined on no input is co-recognizable by multi-stack machines: some multi-stack machine halts on the binary encoding of a code $c$ exactly when the function coded by $c$ is defined on at least one input.
nodes.title: Emptiness is co-recognizable

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions $\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ that are defined on at least one input is recognizable by multi-stack machines: some multi-stack machine halts on the binary encoding of a code $c$ exactly when the function coded by $c$ is defined on some input.
nodes.title: Nonemptiness is recognizable

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
